messages:
Evan H: Quick follow-up on the ETL lag + aggregation corruption incident. Postmortem draft linked here: https://redwood.internal/postmortem/177320. Need explicit owners + timelines.

Rhea G: From initial triage: the merger process hit a resource starvation path (FD exhaustion) which caused serial merges and big latency spikes. Also saw aggregate counts drop ~0.7% on a subset of shards. I'm taking hotfix ownership to ensure the merger doesn't fall back to single-thread. ETA: 24h.

Tom S: I'll own aggregation correctness checks. Plan: add a nightly deterministic vector run and a pre-merge CI guard that compares aggregated outputs. Making it blocking after one successful run. ETA: 72h.

Laila B: Missing spans traced to a batching optimization in telemetry-client that stripped trace headers when batch_size > 1. Rolling back that change temporarily and adding a coverage metric for span propagation. Assigning to me for the permanent fix. ETA: 48h.

releases-bot: rollback completed: release/etl-merger -> release/2026-03-20 by auto-detect (agg_mismatch_rate > 0.5%).

Evan H: Please add these task IDs to the postmortem and tag remediation owners: INC-8120 (hotfix), INC-8121 (agg-tests), INC-8122 (telemetry). Also include a recurrence note (similar pattern on 2026-01-06 and 2026-02-18).

Tom S: CI alert example I'm proposing:
```
alert: AggDiffDetected
expr: agg_output_diff_total > 0
for: 1m
notify: #eng-alerts
```
I'll post the PR for 'agg-guard' later today.

Laila B: telemetry-client@2.4.3 published with header propagation fix and metric telemetry.headers.propagated_count. Added alert if propagated_count drops > 15% vs baseline.

Rhea G: Hotfix PR #5122 merged to release branch. Canary rolling at 10%. Added fd leak detector in integration tests. Monitoring: etl.lag_p95 and agg.diff_rate. Auto-rollback if p95 > 1s for 10m.

Evan H: Action summary (add links):
- Merger hotfix (Rhea) - deploy by 2026-03-25 AM - INC-8120
- Aggregation deterministic tests + CI guard (Tom) - 72h - INC-8121
- Telemetry header patch + span-coverage alert (Laila) - 48h - INC-8122
- Recurrence analysis + quarterly ETL audit (Evan) - propose audit plan by next week - INC-8123

trace-bot: label applied: incident:observability, severity:high

Evan H: Thanks all. Let's have a 30m sync Fri 10:30 PT to validate canary and close action items. Ping this thread if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
